text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Again, huh. What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Air Groove-san?
Why are you sighing like that? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Flower.
To tell you the truth..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The flowers are growing way better than planned.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My! Wouldn't that be a good thing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No, the fact that it was unplanned is the crucial part.
I adjust the fertilizer based on each plant's growth rate,
so now... it has become difficult to estimate the proper amount."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
Then we'll have to let all the flower lovers know about this too!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...? Someone who loves flowers?
I've already finished questioning the Beautification Committee, though.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, umm. I think they might be here
again today, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Is that Taishin?
Why is she spinning that pot around...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“...The sunlight's way too strong.
This little one's gonna get discolored.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...They're packed too close together here.
If I remember right, I need to thin them out...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll take one.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove-san!
Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Morning, Flower.
Thanks to you, I've got a pretty good grasp on things.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* But if they're coming just to look at flowers, they might as well join the Beautification Committee.
I should recommend them myself laterâ

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could we... please just leave that alone?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If both flowers and feelings are startled too much...
they might wither away, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. I'll just bring up our concerns
in passing while discussing other matters."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Flower.
You really know how to raise them well, too."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "That's not... Ehehe. Thank you very much..."
